tools.name: tps_assign_textures
tools.description: Assign Textures: Find and assign textures as single images. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.name: tps_convert_to_udim
tools.description: Convert Textures to UDIM: Convert Image Texture nodes from Single Image to UDIM tiles. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

tools.description: Swap Resolution: Swap image paths to another resolution folder. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.
